subject: general
question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Elucidate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Explicate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that means the same as the given word **"Elucidate"** is **"Explicate".**
 
• **"Elucidate"** means to make clear or explain. It's often used when explaining or clarifying complex concepts or ideas. (स्पष्टीकरण करना)
 
• **"Explicate"** also means to make detailed explanation or interpretation of something. It's used in a similar way to "elucidate".(विस्तार से समझाना)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Explicate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the meanings of the other options:
 
 
• **"Exhaust" **refers to draining someone or something of energy or resources.(थकान)
 
• **"Examine"** means to inspect or look at something closely. (परीक्षा करना)
 
• **"Oracular" **refers to something that is like an oracle, often in terms of being hard to interpret.( भविष्यवाणी संबंधी) 
 
 

31:Td29,

The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
